title: Strokes that make the letter B
prompt: What strokes make the letter B?
hint: One straight vertical line, then two curved lines on the right.
sample: A vertical line and two curved lines.

ja.prompt: 文字の「B」はどのような線で作られますか？
ja.hint: 一本の縦線と、右側の二つの曲線です。
ja.sample: 縦線一本と右側の二つの曲線です。

local.prompt: What strokes make the letter B?
local.hint: One straight vertical line, then two curved lines on the right.
local.sample: A vertical line and two curved lines.

local_pron.prompt: wut strokes mayk thuh LET-er B?
local_pron.hint: wuhn STRAYT VER-ti-kul line, then too kurvd lines on thuh ryt.

zh.prompt: 字母 B 由哪些筆劃組成？

zh.sample: 一條豎線和兩個弧形線。
